import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Create a 2x2 subplot layout for comprehensive fraud analysis
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Credit Card Fraud Detection Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Color palette
fraud_colors = ['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c']  # Green for legitimate, Red for fraud

# 1. Fraud Distribution by Transaction Type
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
fraud_by_type = pd.crosstab(df['transaction_type'], df['is_fraud'])
fraud_by_type.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=fraud_colors, alpha=0.8)
ax1.set_title('Fraud Cases by Transaction Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=10)
ax1.legend(['Legitimate', 'Fraud'], title='Transaction Status')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Transaction Amount Distribution: Fraud vs Legitimate
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
legitimate = df[df['is_fraud'] == 0]['amount']
fraud = df[df['is_fraud'] == 1]['amount']
ax2.hist([legitimate, fraud], bins=30, label=['Legitimate', 'Fraud'], 
         color=fraud_colors, alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_title('Transaction Amount Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax2.legend(title='Transaction Status')
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Fraud Pattern by Hour of Day
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
hourly_fraud = df.groupby(['hour_of_day', 'is_fraud']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
hourly_fraud.plot(kind='area', ax=ax3, color=fraud_colors, alpha=0.6, stacked=False)
ax3.set_title('Fraud Pattern Throughout the Day', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=10)
ax3.legend(['Legitimate', 'Fraud'], title='Transaction Status')
ax3.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 3))
ax3.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 4. Box plot: Amount by Transaction Type and Fraud Status
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
df_plot = df.copy()
df_plot['Status'] = df_plot['is_fraud'].map({0: 'Legitimate', 1: 'Fraud'})
sns.boxplot(data=df_plot, x='transaction_type', y='amount', hue='Status', 
            palette=fraud_colors, ax=ax4)
ax4.set_title('Transaction Amount by Type and Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=10)
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
ax4.legend(title='Transaction Status')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
